proj.twaos.terms.hero.title: TWAOS
proj.twaos.terms.intro: This page serves as both the terms of service and the privacy policy for The Wonderful Adventures Of Sip. Both are short, because there isn't much to say.
proj.twaos.terms.tos.p1: There is no formal terms of service, and that's on purpose. Do whatever you want with the game, as long as you're having fun. The only thing I ask is that you don't ruin the experience for anyone else.
proj.twaos.terms.cc0.title: After Release
proj.twaos.terms.cc0.desc: As far as I'm concerned, once the game is out, it belongs to everyone. Everything I release is dedicated to the public domain under Creative Commons Zero (CC0). No permission needed, no strings attached.
proj.twaos.terms.privacy.p1: I don't collect your data. Not through the game and not through anything connected to it. There are no analytics, no tracking, and no third parties receiving anything, because there is nothing to receive.
